title: Shaded Beige Pipeline Extended 3-Post Grab Bar, 63-Inch Wall Mount ADA Compliant Iron Pipe Bathroom Grab Bar, Allied Brass
body_html:
Finished in Shaded Beige,

Create a safer, more accessible bathroom without giving up industrial style—backed by a limited lifetime warranty, which offers sophisticated warmth in a soft, neutral tone that complements natural materials and earthy palettes. The Pipeline extended 3-post grab bar adds secure support where you need it most, with a third center bracket for enhanced stability.

  • Shaded Beige adds style to a safety essential
  • Choose from 19 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Rely on added stability from the 3-post mounting design with a third center bracket
  • Support daily routines with a 250 lb weight capacity and ADA compliant design
  • Keep the finish looking clean with a durable powder coat designed for corrosion-free, rust-free performance

Complete the look: Coordinate with matching pipeline pieces for a cohesive set of industrial bathroom hardware and pipe-style accessories from the Pipeline collection.

Specs

  • Product type: Extended 3-post grab bar
  • Collection: Pipeline
  • Mounting: Wall mount
  • ADA compliant: Yes
  • Weight capacity: 250 lb
  • Material: Iron Pipe
  • Dimensions: 63 in L x 3 in H x 3.58 in projection/width
  • Product weight: 5 lb
  • Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
  • Assembly required: No
meta_description: 63-inch wall-mounted 3-post grab bar for bathroom safety. ADA compliant iron pipe design supports 250 lb and includes a limited lifetime warranty.
